today.theme: Listen to understand before you respond
today.source: TED@BCG — How to be a great listener
today.listen_task: First pass: identify the listening problem the speakers describe and the question they use to shift the conversation. With the transcript, notice one moment when listening is presented as an action rather than simply staying quiet.
today.speaking_task: In 30 seconds, describe a recent one-to-one conversation. Say what the other person may have needed, then ask one open question before giving your own view.

phrases.phrase: Can you say a little more about that?
phrases.note: Invite detail before you jump to a solution.

phrases.phrase: What would be most helpful right now?
phrases.note: Focus the conversation on the other person's immediate need.

phrases.phrase: Let me check that I've understood.
phrases.note: Confirm meaning before you respond or act.
